execute_plan_migrations: execute all pending MongoDB migrations using the Plan class with automatic rollback on failure
apply_plan_migrations: apply pending MongoDB migrations by running up and validate methods on each migration
rollback_plan_migrations: rollback executed MongoDB migrations in reverse order by calling down on each migration
get_planned_migrations: get the list of pending MongoDB migrations that have not yet been applied to the database
get_saved_migrations_versions: get the list of already applied MongoDB migration versions from the database
